metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Vera Echo
records.biography_en: In The Committee of Bad Habits, Vera Echo takes the role of self-reinforcing echo chamber. “Everyone here agrees with me.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two small tin speaking funnels facing one another.

records.name: Bram Borrowblame
records.biography_en: In The Committee of Bad Habits, Bram Borrowblame takes the role of scapegoating habit. “The arrow was already pointing.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: plain pointing-arrow token held upside down.

records.name: Gus Statuspin
records.biography_en: In The Committee of Bad Habits, Gus Statuspin takes the role of status anxiety. “Is that the top step?”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one small stepped podium ornament and oversized blank badge.

records.name: Jade Thoughtloop
records.biography_en: In The Committee of Bad Habits, Jade Thoughtloop takes the role of rumination. “I was nearly done thinking.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short looped strip of smooth clay ribbon at belly.

records.name: Ned Spiral
records.biography_en: In The Committee of Bad Habits, Ned Spiral takes the role of rising panic. “Please give me a minute.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: palm-sized curled spring clutched in both hands.

records.name: Otto Avoidance
records.biography_en: In The Committee of Bad Habits, Otto Avoidance takes the role of avoidant habit. “I can still hear you from here.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small clay folding screen held sideways at flank, full body visible.
